listing.name: Gearhead Garage: The Virtual Mechanic (OpenGG)
listing.summary: Explore Gearhead Garage: The Virtual Mechanic (OpenGG) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Install or keep your existing copy
steps.instruction: Choose Install for the official portable runtime maintained by Portcove. Installation options retain a non-owning route for an existing or customized copy.

steps.title: Start with the required game files
steps.instruction: On first Play, use GAME FOLDER to choose your installed Gearhead Garage folder containing Data/Cars. The original folder is read-only. NEW creates a mechanic; IMPORT MECHANICS brings over your own .mek saves. Without original files, upstream offers its limited placeholder beta.

steps.title: Keep your progress when updating
steps.instruction: OpenGG normally stores saves, settings, snapshots and logs in AppData/Godot/app_userdata/OpenGG, outside Portcove backups. The package content remains version-owned; no in-folder player-data paths are declared. Keep the default storage mode; register an external copy for custom --user or --data paths.
